name: Peach Pie
subtitle: Fresh
notes: If you don’t have cream cheese: prepare pie crust and bake with cinnamon sugar topping, or after baking, line with a thin layer of homemade jam to reduce moisture seepage.

items: Lemon juice, for tossing the peaches

steps.title: Fill the shell
steps.body: Place **4-6 peaches**, cut and tossed with lemon juice, in pie shell. May add blackberries.

steps.title: Heat the peaches
steps.body: Make the topping: in a saucepan, combine and heat about 1 minute: **1 cup mashed fresh peaches** and **¾ cup water**.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.body: Combine and add to peach mixture: **1 cup sugar** and **3 Tbsp cornstarch**.

steps.title: Cook
steps.body: Cook on medium, stirring occasionally, til thick and clear, then remove from heat and add: **1 Tbsp fresh lemon juice**, **⅛ tsp salt** and **1 Tbsp butter**.

steps.title: Pour and cool
steps.body: Pour over peaches. Cool in refrigerator.
